messages.subject: specifying item names with generate.mirt_object
parts:
I would like to use item names with generate.mirt_object.
How can I specify them?

(When calculating the mirt object with mirt() the item names are retained from the column names of the response frame. I don't know how to achieve the same when generating the object from parameters.)

nitems <- 50
a1 <- rlnorm(nitems, .2,.2)
d <- rnorm(nitems)
pars <- data.frame(a1=a1, d=d, g=g)
rownames(pars)<-paste("i", formatC(seq(1,50), width=2, flag="0"), sep="_")
head(pars)
obj <- generate.mirt_object(pars, '2PL')
coef(obj, simplify = TRUE)
plot(obj, type = 'trace')

Thanks for the help.
Balázs
